scope: new limited allocation experiment; not replication of old E3

trend.weights: select list first, allocate 1/N original slots to trend-qualified symbols, unqualified slots cash, no replacement

timing: completed month-end close -> next valid open; daily exit close -> next valid open
signal_prices: causal economic price index from nominal close, effective cash distributions and cumulative splits since previous valid quote; no future adjustment
accounting: actual units drift; only actual fills charged; record-date dividend entitlement, ex-date receivable, pay-date cash; split units at effectiveness
execution: sell before buy; target units computed from opening marked equity, proportionately shrink purchases for fees, round buys to 100; missing/zero volume/known suspension/locked daily limit delay; no same-day resale of purchases
end_policy: close mark including receivables, no forced liquidation; future open orders not executed
metrics: calendar CAGR365.2425; drawdown includes initial capital; annual return with partial first/last years labelled; average exposure; symbol P&L attribution; fee stress
selection_limit: 4 currently surviving ETFs chosen for verified nominal data and 2 broad / 2 industry coverage, not historical point-in-time whole ETF universe
